chains.trait: Forty-meter graviportal frame with muscular lip-trunks
links: 0.88g gravity reduces skeletal stress on columnar limbs
Nutrient-poor loams select for efficient browsing and symbiotic digestion
Muscular lower lip replaces manual dexterity for harvesting
Slow tectonics preserve stable savanna grazing grounds

skill.effect: The creature wrenches ancient trees from the earth, scattering debris and leaving a wide cleared space. Broken cover crumbles under its weight, yielding a rich harvest for the colony.

chains.weakness: Slow movement; cannot cross deep water or narrow bridges.
observe: Trunk curls around branches stripping leaves with muscular force
Stubby thumbs grip and tear at tree bark
Feet plant heavily, sinking slightly into loam

journal.en: Titans farm the savanna, but the sky is darkening with ice.

plausibility.summary: At 0.88 g, 40 m graviportal megagrazer is at the upper biomechanical ceiling: require avian-style air sacs or slow endothem, columnar limbs with safety factors >2, and minimal running; or shrink body length to ~28–32 m for honest scaling. Lip-trunk: fuse lower lip + nasal proboscis like Elephantidae, not a free lower lip alone.

analogues.organism: African savanna elephant (Loxodonta africana) graviportal stance, trunk (upper lip + nose), skull stress remodelling; extinct titanosaur sauropods for multi-ton terrestrial length (aquatic support absent here).

chains.trait: Massive resonant vocal chambers producing low-frequency booms
links: Enormous body mass dictates low fundamental frequency
Dense atmosphere amplifies these calls across open plains
Stable K2V star and long lifespans support oral tradition preservation
Acoustic propagation maximizes social cohesion in scattered herds

skill.effect: A deep, resonant call echoes across the landscape, sending large predators fleeing into the distance. Allied Titans stand their ground more firmly, drawing strength from the powerful sound.

chains.weakness: Location broadcast; attracts aerial threats and distant enemies.
observe: Chest expands to fill with air before a boom
Ground vibrates noticeably with the call
Herds pause and align faces toward the sound source

journal.en: Myths told in booms that shake the earth; humanity dreams in low frequencies.

plausibility.summary: Tie fundamental frequency to body size (~10–20 Hz infrasound band for largest individuals); 150 m deterrence is plausible for substrate-borne + air coupling on open savanna at 1.1 bar, not magic omnidirectional radar.
